headline: Public hearings on six bond requests: Nashua Public Library renovation, fire training facility, Pine Hill fire station, and an ERP system.
summary: Public hearings were held on bond requests totaling about $21 million for capital equipment, the library, fire training and stations, and an ERP system. Library staff and trustees spoke in favor of the library bond, and two people spoke in opposition. The minutes do not record a vote on any of the resolutions.

A:2 II. 
 
President Lori Wilshire presided; City Clerk Dan Healey recorded.
